verdict.rationale: Issuing credentials is a fair question for an observability SaaS with an API and an MCP server, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no scoped, least-privilege, or agent-specific API keys. The API Reference and MCP Server entries are titles only and say nothing about credential scoping or permissions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
